feedback: Since we did the Successio case study showing how painting videos with big names perform better, I think it’s a loss to have such a generic name when half of the video says how Dostoevsky got basically traumatised by the painting. I just ask you to rethink the title knowing that Successio’s video called ‘This painting drove Hitler, Freud and Dali to obsession’ got 1,1 M views for a channel averaging 3k.
